name: baseline
description: Single-user baseline — how long one transaction takes on an idle system. The denominator for every comparison and the derivation input for concurrency targets. Without it, 'P95 is 30% slower' is meaningless.
_sample_size: Sample count = duration / per-transaction time. At 20s per transaction, 300s yields only 15 samples and P95 is meaningless; if samples are insufficient, add -e DURATION=1800s.
